chaos.instructions: How chaotic will this race be? Rate it on the five-level rubric. The actual level will be the highest level whose condition the race meets.
criteria: 0: calm - no safety car or virtual safety car, at most 2 retirements, and the winner led most laps.
1: lively - a virtual safety car, or 3 to 4 retirements, or 3 or more lead changes.
2: eventful - one full safety car, or a first-lap incident that brought out a yellow flag or a virtual safety car.
3: chaotic - two or more full safety cars, or 5 or more retirements.
4: bedlam - a red flag, or wet running, or a podium with none of the top six starters.

race_lines: Race: the Canadian Grand Prix, round 5 of 23 in the 2026 season, at Circuit Gilles Villeneuve (Montreal, Canada).
The race starts at 20:00 UTC on 24 May 2026, with 22 drivers on the grid.
The grid is provisional: it is the qualifying order, and grid penalties announced after qualifying are not included.
The 2026 season is the first under new technical rules, so the historical rates below come from 2014 to 2025 and are only a rough guide.
This circuit has held 44 championship races, most recently in 2025.

This is a sprint weekend. Sprint result: 1st George Russell; 2nd Lando Norris; 3rd Andrea Kimi Antonelli; 4th Oscar Piastri; 5th Charles Leclerc; 6th Lewis Hamilton; 7th Max Verstappen; 8th Arvid Lindblad.
Rain fell during qualifying (air 21 C, track 31 C).
Constructors' championship after round 4: 1st Mercedes 180 points; 2nd Ferrari 110 points; 3rd McLaren 94 points; 4th Red Bull 30 points; 5th Alpine F1 Team 23 points.
